item.title: Mark Your Calendars: Corbin Bleu Announced for Sing The World 2024! - World Class Vacations by WorldStrides®
item.description: We are thrilled to announce that our celebrity narrator for Sing The World 2024 is none other than the multi-talented Corbin Bleu.

item.title: Fundraising Ideas for Dance The World
item.description: Are you dreaming of dancing your heart out at the magical world of Disney with Dance The World Events? This dream can become a reality for everyone through these fundraising ideas for Dance The World!

item.title: The Magic of Disney Parades
item.description: Picture it: the sun-kissed streets of Main Street, U.S.A., and Disney Springs, alive with anticipation as dancers from around the globe gather to showcase their talents. Here, amidst the iconic sights and sounds of Walt Disney World Resort, the magic of Disney parades unfolds.

item.title: Flower & Garden Festival
item.description: The Flower & Garden Festival at Walt Disney World® offers a unique and immersive opportunity for students participating in the Cook Around The World event to prepare for their culinary journey.

item.title: Cook Around The World
item.description: Last month, we gathered for an amazing culinary adventure, Cook Around The World at the Walt Disney World® Resort from April 26-29, 2024. The event was a tremendous success, and we are overwhelmed with gratitude for everyone who made it possible.
